title: Children in Backyard Wading Pool, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
2478
Here the kids are in their pool -
they've had a lot of fun in it
this summer.
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot depicting three children enjoying a warm summer day in a small, collapsible backyard wading pool set on grass beneath shady trees. The handwritten inscription on the back highlights a tender slice of mid-20th-century family life and suburban American childhood leisure.
